FULL TEXT:
Bhaderwah Campus, University of Jammu
Department of English
Notice
The Walk in Interview for contractual Lectures on lecture basis in the
department of English, which was scheduled to be held on 06-08-2024 stands
postponed till further orders. However, the candidates can still submit their
applications with supporting documents in the Academic Office, Bahderwah
Campus. The candidates are advised to keep in touch with the Campus’
website for the fresh date of Walk in Interview.
Sd/-
I/C Head
